mission: H1 Factory 1.5 zoning staging seam — payload contract pre-registration only
schemaFieldsRationale: Mirror tx_special_district (district identity + GeoJSON geometry + Texas WGS84 bbox + source/vintage/citation + ingested_at) but city-scoped: cityKey/cityGeoId/parentCountyFips replace county-only grain because zoning is a municipal layer that may span or sit inside one county. districtCode/districtName are the normalized stamp contract; codeFieldRaw + codeDomainMapApplied record how the raw ArcGIS value became the code (Elgin A→R-4). geometryCrs + bbox guard projection; isOverlay/isBaseDistrict prevent overlay polygons from being treated as base districts. passthroughAttributes holds the full source attribute bag per the 2026-08-10 harvest-completeness ruling (Elgin exposes ~26 fields; Smithville only ZONING — both must land intact). sourceTier/sourceTierSatisfied track richest-tier honesty. stagingRowId is the primary key for replace/drain semantics analogous to district_row_id.
stagingTableConvention: neondb only; Factory 1.5 SLOT-FREE; mirror 0072_tx_special_district.sql (PK + bbox indexes + county index); drain later via write-special-district-fact-county.mjs pattern — NOT this CP

citiesToStage.whyKnownGood: Wired in ZONING_LAYERS (legacy-design-tools lib/cad-ingest zoning-layers.ts) with live-verified Zone_Code string tokens, CITY_LIMIT='ELGIN' filter, and codeDomainMap including A→R-4; P2.6 dry-run cohort member for Bastrop 48021.
citiesToStage.expectedSchemaShape: Parcel-joined rich attribute schema (~26 fields): OBJECTID, OID_, CALC_ACRE, PIN, PROP_ID, DICT0, ABST_, ABST_NAME, SUB_NAME, SEC_UNIT, LOT, BLK, CITY, COUNTY, Shape_Leng, DEED, CITY_LIMIT, WARD_No, Dev_Agree, DevAgrDate, Dev_Ord_No, Zoning (string long name), Zone_Code (string district token), Annex, AnnexDate, Zon_Ord_No. Sample attrs Zone_Code=R-1, Zoning=Single Family, CITY_LIMIT=ELGIN, PROP_ID=R77690. Native extent WKID 102739 (Texas Central State Plane ft). Feature count CITY_LIMIT=ELGIN: 3220.

Live-probed 2026-08-12: (1) GET FeatureServer/0?f=pjson for name/geometryType/extent/fields; (2) GET /query?where=1=1&outFields=*&returnGeometry=false&resultRecordCount=1&f=pjson for sample attributes; (3) GET /query?returnCountOnly=true confirming count=91. Confirmed NOT identically schemed to Elgin.
citiesToStage.expectedSchemaShape: Minimal two-field polygon layer: OBJECTID (esriFieldTypeOID) + ZONING (esriFieldTypeString, no coded domain, no description twin). Sample attrs: {OBJECTID:1, ZONING:"C-3"}. No PROP_ID/PIN/CITY_LIMIT/acres/ward/annex fields. Native extent WKID 102739. Feature count: 91. NOT wired in ZONING_LAYERS (city #24+ candidate per P2.6).
citiesToStage.whySchemaDivergesFromCity1: Elgin is a parcel-attribute join with separate Zone_Code (token) + Zoning (long name) plus ~24 CAD/admin columns and a mandatory codeDomainMap; Smithville is a bare district-polygon layer whose single string field ZONING is both code and sole attribute — no descriptionField, no domain map, no parcel identity columns, ~35× fewer features.

divergenceHypothesis: Elgin FeatureServer/0 exposes a parcel-joined string dual (Zone_Code token + Zoning long name) plus rich CAD/admin columns and requires codeDomainMap (legacy A→R-4); Smithville FeatureServer/0 exposes only OBJECTID+ZONING with no description twin, no coded domain, and no parcel identity fields — proving the staging normalizer cannot assume a fixed ArcGIS field set or that codeField≡descriptionField, and must map city-specific registry rows into the shared payload contract while retaining passthroughAttributes for harvest completeness.

adversarialTrapCatalog.catchMechanism: Composite staging PK stagingRowId = cityKey + ':' + objectId (or hash of cityKey+geometry+districtCode); drain and stamp always filter by cityKey; never unique-index districtCode alone. Both cities can emit C-3 with different ordinance meaning.

Record geometryCrs from query outSR; assert Texas WGS84 bbox on westLng/southLat/eastLng/northLat after any 102739→4326 reproject (same assertTexasWgs84Bbox posture as txgio). Fail closed if native WKID is neither 4326 nor a registered reproject path; never persist State Plane feet as GeoJSON degrees.

parentCountyFips is registry primary (Census/CAPCOG); multi-county span list recorded on registry row when known. Staging rows carry cityKey+cityGeoId as identity; drain may fan out to multiple county parcel rosters via PIP, never assume one FIPS owns all polygons. Elgin already has a named Travis-side FeatureServer/1 follow-on — do not silently merge layers.

isOverlay/isBaseDistrict required on every staged row; registry nullDistrictCodes + layerWhere exclude non-districts (ROW/OCL patterns). Default isBaseDistrict=true only when layer is documented as base zoning; overlays require explicit registry flag. Drain refuses to stamp overlays as districtCode without isBaseDistrict=true.
